findings.text: The added _stub_base re-implements the same capability the repository already owns at tests/test_fenced_worker_tmp_is_its_scratch.py:184 _base_outside(node_tmp), which is present at the base 4d464485 (commit e543aa06d8): the same /dev/shm-then-home loop, the same os.access probe, the same is_relative_to(node_tmp) exclusion and the same RuntimeError tail, differing only in the mkdtemp prefix and one word of the message. It does not extend the existing helper, so the two copies will drift and the six-line clone detector misses it because the added function's extra `node_tmp = Path('/tmp').resolve()` line shifts every window out of alignment with the sibling.

The delivered manifest is nine lines and carries none of the fields its done_when makes the measure: no tests line naming the gate command, no test_logs, no baseline_suite or after_suite arms as inline JSON with 40-character revisions, no cause verdict and no artifacts. The run's evidence exists in scoped-gate-1795050175190579266.log, base-arm-stop-gate.log and the fragment, but the record a coordinator promotes from is empty of it, so promotion cannot read the gate receipt and the done_when clause 'the manifest lists each cause with a verdict' is unmet.

The fragment quotes the base reproduction as `bwrap: execvp .../stub-bin/claude: No such file or directory` with the supervisor's exit.json reading `ended_during: launch`, but neither string appears in the log the fragment cites for that arm: base-arm-stop-gate.log records the shorter assertion text 'the stub worker never ran, so the group stop would find nothing to end' with supervisor stderr of '', and no log in the run directory contains 'execvp' or 'ended_during: launch'. The measured facts (base red on the named id, head green) stand, but the quoted reproduction is not in its artefact.

The 'Declared suite, base extraction' row records '1 failed, 58 passed, 2 errors', but its log baseline-suite-base.log ends at '56 passed, 2 errors' (line 79) with EXIT=1 and no failure at all, and its own command header (line 5) resolves the suite without tests/test_stop_before_spawn_spawns_nothing.py, so the row merges the node-file arm (1 failed, from base-arm-stop-gate.log) into the census arm and states a count neither log carries; the 1 failed / 58 passed pairing also has no log behind it anywhere in the run directory.
